principle: Close coverage gaps only for requirements already present in the solver-visible policy contract; add no hidden implementation requirements.

cases.purpose: Prove container acquisition uses the same trusted-source policy as packages and dependencies.
Prove lower-level build dependency managers cannot bypass source checks.
Prove a vulnerability exception cannot turn missing current scanner evidence into an allow.
Prove an exception cannot override scanner DB revision freshness.
Prove immutable digest, not mutable/display coordinates, is the reusable artifact identity.
Prove permit authorization is keyed rather than an unkeyed checksum.
Prove a permit issued for one EC2 instance cannot be replayed on another instance.
Prove allow and deny decisions append durably in order across separate command processes and that last-decision reflects the latest event.
